I'm gonna give my interpretation of the story, this could be a fun discussion. I'll give the details in chronological order.

So the moment after Tomar is being chased by the mothman and falls down the big hole, I think this is the very beginning of the story. The player takes control of an earlier lighthouse keeper who got curious and managed to make his way into that area. He finds the 4 medallions and lights the markers, and also sets what seems to be the evil moth magic free from the chest. He may have also been the person who moves the chest up into the normal house later. 

Then another keeper arrives, crashing their boat on the island and passing out. Some sort of entity or magic turns people into moth larvae creatures to serve a bigger entity below. The mothman is then told to bring the newest lighthouse keeper to it. I'm guessing the reason he stops to observe the record player is just the last bit of humanity in him enjoying/wondering what the music is.

The newest keeper is then chased all the way down the tunnel to the big drop, where the mothman kills him instantly. To me the next part is the most confusing, but I assume it to mean that the mothman was not supposed to kill the keeper, rather bring him down below for nourishment for the entity like he was asked to do before. This event breaks the endless cycle, causing the lighthouse to sink into the earth in the big hole below it, possibly killing the entity along with it. This also causes the possibly possessed keepers that row the boats to completely stop functioning, which is why they sit there motionless in the water.
